Nothing here is applied. The live Indianapolis authority is untouched by this file.

reader_findings_worth_carrying_forward: The Wyndham policy dialog heading is NOT stable: this market served both 'PET & SERVICE ANIMAL POLICY' and 'PET POLICY' on the same brand family. A reader anchored on the longer heading alone silently misses the shorter one -- 'days inn by wyndham plainfield' read as SOURCE_SILENT until the heading regex was widened.

Wyndham's static markup carries only booking boilerplate ('...and pets (if allowed)') plus marketing prose. That boilerplate is NOT a property policy and must never establish a fact. The operative text appears only after the Hotel Policies control is activated.

Best Western serves the operative policy inside the static markup as a FACILITY/PETS attribute value, so it is reachable free without a browser; its amenity code block ('PET|PETS ALLOWED|LIMITED - PETS') is chip-only and must not be used.
